work.description: The exact selected raw OCR extent and surrounding boundary context were inspected. Printed attribution is preserved; this is not modern authentication, critical dating or image-collated text. Independent LIX act issued under the literal Clement XI protocol at 20400-20401. Innocent XI in the synopsis and inserted decree is the predecessor whose earlier brief is at issue, not the current outer issuer. The Congregation decree expressly introduced 20403-20408 is retained through its operative decision at 20423/20434-20437, dating 20437, and signatures 20438-20439; outer papal confirmation resumes 20441. Historical title note 20425-20429 belongs to the marker at 20398 and is retained in full. Complete final clauses, outer dating 20517-20519, and repeated date 20521 are printed, despite empty date_raw; date remains null. Literal etc at 20418 abbreviates the incorporated cause-identification rubric after quatuor tantum, not the current decree's operative decision or the outer confirmation; preserve it without expansion, and do not claim a complete transcription of the earlier Innocent XI brief. No current substantive body is replaced by a cross-reference. Next LX starts 20524; its title apparatus 20541-20545 and subsequent notes belong to that next act and are not added here. Admission is of the complete bounded printed witness, with no overlap against prior accepted acts, fragments, or constituents.
